policy: Only Arabic-inspected Bengali-script pronunciation is marked revised; the transliteration remains an aid and is not tajwid-certified.
source: Verified records were reviewed against Arabic and Bengali pronunciation conventions; generated draft entries are retained only as unverified drafts and are not represented as fully manually verified.

audit.method: Arabic-inspected Bengali pronunciation revision; original Arabic, translation, and verse numbers preserved.

draft.method: Remaining verses are unchanged drafts and still require direct revision.
